plain.li: {X_nameDef} told me things about the far country I'll be turning over for days.
Talked half the evening with {X_nameDef}. Their people do everything differently, and some of it better.
[x:faction:Outland_Empire] Tea with {X_nameDef}. I was told to look at it before drinking. I looked. It was still tea, but I see the point now.
[x:faction:Outland_MotzCoalition] {X_nameDef} sat just past the lamplight all evening. I turned the lamp down and the talk got better.
[x:faction:Outland_RedburnPact] Haggled with a goblin. Came out even. I'm told that's a compliment.
[x:faction:Outland_VathunNobles] {X_nameDef} asked my caste. I'm still not sure what I should have said.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} was kind to me in a way I didn't expect from a stranger. I hope the road is kind to {X_objective}.

cheerful.li: Every visitor from out there is stranger than the last, and I love it!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef}'s people seem to have it all worked out. We're still guessing.

cold.li: Learned how {X_nameDef}'s people do business. Worth knowing.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} has come further than anyone I've met, and is going further still.
A knight told me about a shrine at the end of a road that has taken years to walk. I don't think I could do it. I'd like to be the sort who could.
[skill:Animals] {X_nameDef} calmed our most nervous animal with a song I'd never heard. I've been humming it at the pens since.
[skill:Intellectual] {X_nameDef} showed me how to tell the hour by the stars. I stayed up to try it, and it works.
[x:factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.mongols] Drank mare's milk with a rider from the steppe. Strangest thing I've ever tasted. I had a second cup.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} said our colony would be a good stop on any road. I hope they come back this way.

blunt.li: Foreign visitor. Good stories. Bad singing.

cheerful.li: There's a whole world of kingdoms out there, and every one of them argues about something different!

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} talks about their kingdom like it'll last forever. They always do.

cold.li: The kingdoms beyond the hills are bigger than I thought. We should know more about them.

plain.li: [xeno:AG_Nereid] Told {OTHER_nameDef} about the deep today, and {OTHER_nameDef} listened like a child at a fire. I didn't know how much I'd been wanting to tell someone.
[!xeno:AG_Nereid] {OTHER_nameDef} held {OTHER_possessive} breath while I counted. I gave up at three hundred.
[!xeno:AG_Nereid] {OTHER_nameDef} says the sea floor is like a forest at night, only slower. I keep thinking about it.

warm.li: [xeno:AG_Nereid] {OTHER_nameDef} asked whether I miss the water. Every morning, I said, and {OTHER_pronoun} said {OTHER_pronoun}'d help me dig the pond deeper.

cheerful.li: [!xeno:AG_Nereid] I am going to learn to swim properly, and {OTHER_nameDef} is going to teach me!

gloomy.li: [xeno:AG_Nereid] Talking about the deep only made me miss it more.

plain.li: Came in half frozen and {OTHER_nameDef} took my hands in {OTHER_possessive} until I could feel my fingers again. Hotter than the stove, that one.
Sat next to {OTHER_nameDef} on the coldest night yet. Better than any blanket. I didn't say so, but I think {OTHER_pronoun} knew.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} warmed my hands without being asked. Small thing. I won't forget it.

blunt.li: Cold. {OTHER_nameDef} is warm. Sat close. Done.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} breathed on my fingers and the frost went off them in a puff of steam!

plain.li: [xeno:AG_Lapis] Showed {OTHER_nameDef} where the seam runs today, and {OTHER_nameDef} marked it in chalk. Most people just nod.
[!xeno:AG_Lapis] {OTHER_nameDef} put a hand on the rock and told me where the ore was. Three hands left of where I'd have dug, and right, too.
[!xeno:AG_Lapis] {OTHER_nameDef} licked a lump of ore to tell what it was. I'm not going to try that.

cold.li: Learned to hear a fault in the rock by tapping. Useful.

plain.li: [meme:AM_Artist] Drew {OTHER_nameDef} today in a dozen lines on the back of a feed sack. Got the nose right, I think.
[!meme:AM_Artist] {OTHER_nameDef} drew me today. I didn't know I looked like that. I think I like it.
[!meme:AM_Artist] {OTHER_nameDef} says my face has a lot of weather in it. I'm choosing to take that well.

cheerful.li: [!meme:AM_Artist] {OTHER_nameDef} drew me! I'm going to pin it up by my bed.

gloomy.li: [meme:AM_Artist] Drew {OTHER_nameDef}. It came out sadder than {OTHER_pronoun} looks. Or maybe not.

plain.li: [!meme:AM_WaterPrimacy] {OTHER_nameDef} touched water to my brow and said the old words. I felt washed through, which is not something I expected to write.
[!meme:AM_Monastic] {OTHER_nameDef} sat with me without a word until I could breathe again. Ten breaths, and start over. It works.
[meme:AM_Monastic] Sat in silence with {OTHER_nameDef}, who needed it. Silence is the only thing I have to give, and it was enough.
[meme:AM_WaterPrimacy] Blessed {OTHER_nameDef} with water today. {OTHER_nameDef} stood very still for it.

warm.li: Someone was there for me today without needing me to explain anything. I'll try to be that for someone else.

plain.li: [meme:AM_Cowboys] Leaned on the fence with {OTHER_nameDef} and talked herds until dark. There's the makings of a rancher in {OTHER_objective}.
[!meme:AM_Cowboys] {OTHER_nameDef} showed me how to throw a loop over a post. I caught the post eventually, and {OTHER_nameDef} twice.

cheerful.li: Out at the pens with {OTHER_nameDef} counting the animals. We agree the goat is the cleverest. The goat agrees too.
